test_vertex_client_launch: test the vertex Client.launch method to launch a job on Google Cloud Vertex AI with mocked credentials
test_get_machine_spec_default: test vertex.get_machine_spec returns n1-standard-4 as the default machine type for a job with no requirements
test_get_machine_spec_gpu: test vertex.get_machine_spec returns n1-standard-4 with NVIDIA_TESLA_P100 accelerator for a GPU job requirement
test_get_machine_spec_a100: test vertex.get_machine_spec returns a2-highgpu-2g with NVIDIA_TESLA_A100 accelerator for an A100 GPU job requirement
test_get_machine_spec_tpu: test vertex.get_machine_spec returns cloud-tpu with TPU_V3 accelerator for a TPU job requirement
test_cpu_ram_to_machine_type: test vertex.cpu_ram_to_machine_type maps CPU and RAM values to the optimal GCP machine type string
test_cpu_ram_to_machine_type_too_high: test vertex.cpu_ram_to_machine_type raises ValueError when CPU and RAM exceed all valid machine types
